UltraGrid 1.10.8 (tags/v1.10.8 rev 5d44e6b built Aug 24 2026 07:14:08)

Core Audio playback usage:
	-r coreaudio[:<index>|:<name>] [--param audio-buffer-len=<len_ms>] [--param audio-disable-adaptive-buffer]
where
	<name> - device name substring (case sensitive)

Available CoreAudio playback devices:
	coreaudio    : Default CoreAudio playback
	coreaudio:104: BlackHole 16ch
	coreaudio:120: BlackHole 2ch
	coreaudio:136: BlackHole 64ch
	coreaudio:92 : MacBook Pro Speakers
	coreaudio:152: Microsoft Teams Audio
	coreaudio:166: NDI Audio
	coreaudio:179: ZoomAudioDevice
	coreaudio:61 : AggregateDevice
Exit
